amendments.reason: The source has a dative/reflexive reference, not an omission instruction. Remove the erroneous source attribution while retaining the original prompt and model.

primary_inspection.observation: Personally reread original45.7: bought wheat (hwǣte,44) for ourselves (161;184.a). No om. instruction accompanies ourselves.

changes.before: The original comment that “for ourselves” may be omitted permits either the visible benefactive/reflexive dative ūs or its omission. The model retains ūs after bohton: we bought wheat for ourselves. It is not an accusative thing purchased.
changes.after: Ūs is the benefactive/reflexive dative in bohton ūs hwǣte: we bought wheat for ourselves. It refers to the buying subject and is not the accusative thing purchased. The original 45.7 prompt contains no instruction to omit this phrase.
